relationships.subject: skin/muscle incision and retraction
relationships.evidence_quote: our findings provided evidence that SMIR induces the Epac/PKCβ pathway in the DRG

relationships.subject: Epac1/PKCβII pathway
relationships.evidence_quote: Under the influence of agonists of Epac/PKC, normal rats showed mechanical allodynia and increased Glut1, VEGF, and PGP9.5 proteins.

relationships.subject: Epac1/PKCβII pathway
relationships.evidence_quote: suppression of Epac1 and PKCβII decreased the Glut1, VEGF, PGP9.5 proteins and increased the EPO protein in the DRG of rats after SMIR operation for seven days

relationships.subject: Epac1/PKCβII pathway
relationships.evidence_quote: SMIR-operated rats with adenovirus-mediated Epac1 deficiency showed the lower mRNA expression of proinflammatory factors including TNF-α, IL-1β, and MCP-1 in the DRG

relationships.subject: Epac1/PKCβII pathway
relationships.evidence_quote: 8-pCPT treatment caused the upregulation of Epac1, Glut1, VEGF, and PGP9.5 proteins as well as the downregulation of EPO protein in the SMIR-operated rats

relationships.subject: Captopril
relationships.evidence_quote: Pretreatment with Captopril enhanced mechanical withdrawal threshold (Fig. 5A) and decreased MCP-1 expression in DRG (Fig. 5B) in rats after SMIR operation for seven days.

key_findings: SMIR activated Epac1/PKCβII in DRG, with increased Glut1, VEGF, PGP9.5 and decreased EPO; agonists reproduced allodynia in normal rats and Epac1 knockdown or LY333531 reversed it.
Captopril, used to protect vascular endothelial cells, reduced SMIR mechanical hypersensitivity and DRG MCP-1.
